paite: Chihtaktakin dangka adingin khuk a oma, huan a hihsiang uh dangkaeng adingin mun.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

paite: Lei akipanin sik a kilakhia a, huan suang akipanin dal a ki sungkhia hi.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

paite: Mihingin khomial phaktawp a neisaka, huan khomial sah leh thukah phaktawp gamlapen tanin sik-bua a zongkhia.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

paite: Mite om louhna ah kokhuk lutna hawm a tou vangua, mite apat gamla ah a kikhai ua, khatlam khatlamah a ki vei uh.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

paite: Lei ahihleh, huai akipanin tanghou a hongsuaka: huan a nuaiah meia hihbangin a kilumlet hi.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

paite: Huailaia suangte saphir suang mun ahi a, huan dangkaeng nen a nei hi.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

paite: Huai lampi sasial ne vasain a theikei a, mu-akla mitin leng a mu ngei sam kei hi.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

paite: Gamsa kisatheiten a sikkha ngeikei ua, humpinelkai lunlai leng huailaiah a paikha neikei hi.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

paite: Meisah suanpi tungah a khut a koiha; a zungin mualte a lumlet a lumlet hi.
english: He puts forth his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

paite: Suangpite lakah lam a tou honga; huan a mitin thil mangpha chiteng a mu hi.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

paite: A takkhiak louhna ding un lui luangte a tuama; huan thilkisel khovak ah a honlakhia a.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings forth to light.

paite: Himahleh ko ilaiah a pilna a kimu dia? Huan theihsiamna mun koilaia om ahia?
english: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: Mihingin a lampi a theikei hi; mihing gamah leng muhin a om kei hi.
english: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

paite: Tui thukin, Ka kiangah a omkei, a chi a.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

paite: Dangkaenga muh theih ahi keia, huai man dingin dangka leng buk theih ahi kei hi.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.

paite: Ophir dangkaeng toh a manphatna teh theih ahi kei ding, onik mantam hiam saphir toh hiam.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire or, lapis lazuli .

paite: Dangkaeng leh limlangin a kimpih theikei ua: huai khenna dingin dangkaeng hoih suangmantam leng ahi theikei ding hi.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

paite: Suang dum hiam suang muhpaisuak theih a kigen kei ding: A hi, pilna man rubi suang sangin a sangjaw hi.
english: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

paite: Ethiopia topazi suangin a pha kei dia, dangkaeng tak toh leng a manphatna teh ding ahi kei.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

paite: Ahihleh pilna koi akipana hongpai ahia? Huan theihsiamna mun koia om hia?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: Mihing tengteng mit akipana sel ahi chih leh, huihkhua a vasate akipan sitsa a om ahi chih theiin.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

paite: Siatna leh sihnain, huaia thuthang ka bil un ka ja uh, a chi ua.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

paite: Huaia lampi Pathianin a theisiam, huai amun a thei hi.
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

paite: Lei mong tanin a en ngala, huan van nuai thil tangtang a mu hi.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

paite: Huiha dinga gikna a piak lain, leh tuite tehna a a teh laiin;
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

paite: Vuah adinga thupiak a bawla, vanging khophia adia lampi a bawl laiin;
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;

paite: Huailaiin aman a mua, a phuanga; ahih kipa, ahi, a zong khia hi.Huan mihing kiangah, Ngaiin, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi: huan hoihlou akipan pai mang theisiamna ahi, a chi hi.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

paite: Huan mihing kiangah, Ngaiin, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi: huan hoihlou akipan pai mang theisiamna ahi, a chi hi.
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” , that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
